notes:
Summary: Verdant Halo is a mid-market contact-center platform used by European banks. Primary interest is real-time agent assist (streaming suggestions + short canned responses), automated ticket summarization, and deterministic tool-calling for actions (create ticket, initiate refund, escalate to supervisor).

Requirements / constraints (raw):
- Latency SLOs: initial suggestion token <100ms, prefix stream continuity <200ms, end-to-end suggestion delivery under 500ms for 90th pct.
- Throughput: 120 concurrent agents today, expect 300+ on marketing days (4x spike). Need predictable autoscaling or reserved pools.
- Guardrails: hallucination mitigation, cite-sources mode for knowledge-base answers, automatic rollback on hallucination alerts.
- Tool-calling: actions must be auditable + idempotent; need signed audit trail + support for synchronous tool confirmation back to agent UI.
- Security: EU data residency mandatory; SSO via Okta / SAML; require SOC2 report and support for customer-managed KMS.
- Integration: Genesys Cloud + Zendesk backend routing; want SDK examples and a sample streaming quickstart.

POC ask: 4-week POC. Goals: integrate streaming suggestions into agent UI, validate latency under 200ms p95, test tool-calls (create ticket, escalate workflow), and run a simulated 3x spike. Success metrics: latency SLOs met, <3% hallucination rate on KB answers, tool-calls 100% auditable.

Financial / procurement: Procurement legal flagged indemnity clause; prefer annual reserved capacity if Dedicated gives better SLOs. Estimate ARR in range $250k-$750k depending on Dedicated commit.

Quotes / paraphrases: 'We can't have agents waiting — suggestions must feel instantaneous', 'If latency slips during spikes, agents will turn it off.'

Open technical questions: what pre-warm / warmup strategy for KV cache across EU nodes? How does Redwood handle model fallback during capacity loss (automated routing to quantized variant)? Need a sample cost calc for token + concurrency vs Dedicated monthly commit.

Files / refs: pricing deck (drive link), security FAQ (drive link), Fireflies meeting ids above.
